errors.evidence: The reference description does not specify the left-right order of the bars, but the image shows the orange bar (验证集数量) is consistently to the right of the blue bar (训练集数量). The machine-generated description incorrectly states the blue bar is on the left, which is correct visually but contradicts the phrasing '蓝柱在左、橙柱在右' as if it were a general rule rather than an observation.
The reference description mentions the logical order of categories on the horizontal axis, but the machine-generated description only states the order without emphasizing its logical basis.
